name: triage
description: Waiting for the triage agent

name: refining
description: A spec is being written

name: needs-answer
description: The issue can't go on without the owner; the owner answers by commenting

name: needs-approval
description: The spec is complete and waits for the owner's yes (label approved)

name: ready
description: Meets the Definition of Ready; the dispatcher starts an implement agent

name: in-progress
description: An implement agent is building it

name: in-review
description: A pull request is open

name: origin:owner
description: Asked by the owner

name: origin:agent
description: Asked by an agent

name: origin:external
description: Asked by anyone who is neither the owner nor an agent

name: route:direct
description: Triage route: no refinement, straight to ready

name: route:lean
description: Triage route: lean refinement

name: route:full
description: Triage route: full refinement

name: merge:self
description: Merge class: the implement agent may merge once CI is green

name: merge:agent
description: Merge class: the review agent may merge when it approves and CI is green

name: merge:human
description: Merge class: only the owner merges

name: approved
description: Owner only: yes to implement the spec as written

name: objection
description: An agent advises against this issue; the reason is in a comment

name: budget:extend
description: Owner only: this issue may spend one more per-issue cap

name: paused
description: The issue reached its per-issue cap; resumes when the owner sets budget:extend
